title: Thread wakeup graph
description: Directed edge list built from sched:sched_wakeup: which thread wakes which. Drawn as a force directed graph by the viewer; hub nodes are the interesting ones.

nodes.description: Optional node metadata. Threads referenced by an edge but missing here are still valid; the viewer falls back to meta/threads.json and then to the bare tid.

external.description: True when the tid does not belong to the target process (kernel threads, other processes).

total_us.description: Summed wakeup to on-CPU latency for this edge, when runqlat data is correlated. Null when not measured.
